articles.summary: PBF Holding plans a $500M private senior-notes offering due 2034, with net proceeds and cash earmarked to redeem its 6.00% notes maturing in 2028.
articles.title: PBF Energy Announces Intention to Offer $500 Million of Senior Notes due 2034

articles.summary: New 7.25% senior notes due 2034, co-issued by PBF Holding and PBF Finance, are expected to fund a conditional June 25 redemption of $801.6M 6.00% 2028 notes.
articles.title: PBF Energy Announces Pricing of $500 Million of Senior Notes due 2034

articles.summary: Management will attend Bank of America Energy and Power Credit Conference on June 3, 2026; any presentation materials will post on PBF Energy’s investor site.
articles.title: PBF Energy to Participate in Bank of America Energy and Power Credit Conference
